summary: 23 CPU-first media tools behind one MCP server: background removal, EXIF/GPS stripping, resize, thumbnails, GIFs, video trim. 22 of them report "network": "none" in their own response payload rather than in a README, and a test fails if any other module ever imports an HTTP client. No GPU, no paid API. 326 tests.
